COMPUTER STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.

2. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.

3. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

10. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.

11. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.

14. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

15. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
